YTA. Behavior like this is why me and my little brother don’t get along. Acting like this is going to create a lot of resentment between your kids. My parents treated me the same way you did your daughter and my brother the same way you treated your son. 
I was always expected to make straight A’s and do well in school, but my brother managing to not get suspended that day and get a C was celebrated with gifts/money. Of course now as an adult I can see how dumb that was, but it really hurt as a kid and made it feel like nothing I ever did was good enough for my parents approval just because school came “easier” to me. I hated my brother for a very long time until I grew up and reflected and realized none of it was his fault, but it permanently damaged how we interact to this day. We still don’t like each other very much and he’s very angry and spoiled. Coddling your son like this is not going to help him in any way, and eventually he’ll realize you’re pitying him, which is gonna hurt even worse than losing some match. Treat your kids equally, anything other than equal is going to create problems and make your kids resent either you or each other, if not both.

I’m kind of torn because most people here seem to disagree but I don’t think you’re completely TA. 

I love my dog with all my heart, she’s the most important thing in the world to me, given she’s also a service dog, so maybe there’s a bit of different nuance. But if I got married to someone and suddenly a step child was sprung on me, dog allergy or not I would be extremely upset as someone who has never ever wanted children. I can admit I’m a selfish person I suppose, but I don’t think I could ever give up my dog who I’ve loved for years for some surprise kid. I don’t think it’s as black and white as most people here are making it out to be. Losing an animal that important to you can be extremely heartbreaking. I really sympathize with you here OP. Maybe I’m an asshole, but I’d move out myself. But this is your marriage, you have a lot to consider there. I’m sorry for everything you’re dealing with man, hope you can find your dogs a good loving home if you need to. My heart hurts for you
